# Coretax Renamer

Coretax Renamer is a privacy-first web application for batch-renaming Coretax Faktur Pajak PDFs.

- URL: /
- Type: Web application (PWA)
- Core capability: Extract invoice reference, buyer name, and faktur code from PDF text and generate standardized filenames.
- Processing: Fully client-side; no document upload required.
- Offline behavior: Supported after first load via service worker caching.

## Audience

- Finance and tax operations teams handling Coretax-exported PDFs.
- Users needing deterministic and repeatable PDF filename conventions.

## Key features

1. Batch PDF ingest with drag-and-drop.
2. Configurable delimiter and filename template placeholders: `{invoice}`, `{name}`, `{kode}`, `{d}`.
3. Duplicate filename collision handling.
4. Offline-capable Progressive Web App.

## Privacy and security

- No server-side PDF parsing.
- File processing remains in the browser runtime.
